Explore the scenic river system, learn about the areas rich in Native American and maritime history, view wildlife. See costal areas, marshes, bayous and the largest scenic river in the State. Stops at several popular waterfront restaurants optional(including: The Anchor-casual dining & Daiquiris bar, Morton’s- seafood, The Blind Tiger- costal Restaurant and T Rivers bar & grill- for those picking up lunch/ dinner to go. services.name: Individual Tickets
services.desc: Boat departs from Fairview Riverside State Park. See the Tchefuncte River, the bayous and Lake Ponchatrain on a 2 hour narrated trip covering the areas history as well as the wildlife that calls it home. It is okay to pack a small cooler for your own snacks and drinks. 2 All Ages • 2 Hours

quotes.author: Veronica Giambrone Corcoran
quotes.text: I want to thank Mike for a wonderful trip we had over the weekend! My friends and I truly enjoyed having him ride us around on the river! We had a great get away and I will definitely be booking again! He was right on time, and very accommodating! He was very knowledgeable on the river and can tell you whatever you want!! We enjoyed having someone ride us around and just relax!! Thanks again!

quotes.author: Janis Boulmay
quotes.text: Mike is the best, our group of ladies had a wonderful time cruising the Tchefunta. We did the sunset cruise minus the sunset 😄 due to clouds. We will definitely book with LA Tours and Rentals again. He is a great tour guide pointing out everything you would want to know about the river. Thanks Mike!

quotes.author: Madison Burns
quotes.text: Mike was an amazing! We were celebrating my birthday & we all had the BEST time. Easy pick up & drop off. He took us anywhere we wanted to go and even stopped to let us swim. The boat had everything we needed! I would recommend everybody to rent with Mike! It was a beautiful day on the river!

quotes.author: Katy Esposito
quotes.text: My family and I had an absolutely amazing time with Mike during our 3 hour boat rental! He was easy to contact and answered all of my questions ahead of time! He was also very flexible and accommodating. We will definitely boat with him again!! Highly highly recommend!

quotes.author: Kathy Morris
quotes.text: We had a wonderful time on the river today celebrating our dad’s 90th birthday. It was a beautiful, relaxing experience we all enjoyed. The boat was spacious and comfortable and Mike is an excellent captain! We look forward to doing it again!

quotes.author: Verena Walther
quotes.text: Thank you to Mike for a wonderful day on the Tchefuncte River and nearby tributary rivers. Very knowledgeable on the water ways, the animals and plants. He picked us up at a Marina of our choice. We recommend booking with them!
